嫦娥奔月 / 张世明绘; 夏虹改编. —天津 : 新蕾出版社,

中国版本图书馆CIP数据核字(2010)第012169号
后羿射日
张世明 绘 夏虹 改编

[P4] 很久以前，世界上一共有十个太阳，他们住在大海中央的扶桑树上。
每天，他们轮流出现在天空里，所以地面上的人只能看见一个太阳。
公鸡“喔喔喔”地打鸣，太阳的妈妈曦和来接他们值班。

[P5] 曦和带着一个太阳坐上车，六条龙拉着他们在天空中飞奔。

[P6] 千百万年来，天天都要上班下班，十个太阳觉得太没劲了。一天早上，没等妈妈来接，它们就一块涌到天空里，蹦蹦跳跳地玩起来。
5
十个太阳的阳光太强烈了，烤焦了土地，晒死了庄稼苗，人们活不下去了。
6

[P7] 他们的爸爸帝俊知道了这件事，非常生气，就派后羿去教训那十个家伙。
7
后羿带着帝俊给他的一张弓十支箭，和妻子嫦娥一起来到人间。他
看见许多人都被晒死了，活着的也只剩下一把骨头，心里难过极了。
8

[P8] 后羿拉弓搭箭，瞄准太阳，警告他们别再胡闹，可十个家伙压根不搭理他，继续在天空中活蹦乱跳。
9
后羿“嗖”地一箭射了出去！

[P9] 一个太阳落到地上，变成一只金灿灿的乌鸦，剩下的九个慌了神，四处逃窜。
11
后羿“嗖嗖嗖”连射八箭，一箭射中一个太阳。
12

[P10] 人们担心后羿把十个太阳都射杀了，没有太阳，万物不能生长。于是有个人从后羿的箭袋里偷偷抽出一只箭。

[P11] 15  从此以后，太阳就老老实实的，每天按时出来，把阳光洒向大地。
16  嫦娥奔月

[P12] 后羿射死了
九个太阳，帝俊
很愤怒，下令把
后羿和嫦娥贬
为凡人，永世不
得再上天庭。

嫦娥很伤心，她原本是个
女神，可以长生
不老，现在却只
能像凡人一样
慢慢老去。

[P13] 后羿很内疚，他四处打听，终于发现昆仑山的西王母藏着不死药。于是，
他告别了嫦娥，到昆仑山去寻药。
昆仑山四周环绕着高耸入云的大山，山上烧着熊熊大火，能把铜化成汁，
19 铁化成水，但是它们挡不住勇敢的后羿。

[P14] 昆仑山下环绕着一道大河，名叫弱水。飞鸟掉下的羽毛，一落在水面上就沉了下去。不过，这也挡不住坚强的后羿。昆仑山高一万一千一百一十四步二尺六寸，不死树在西面。

[P15] 历经艰险，后羿终于爬上了昆仑山顶，上面长着一种木禾，高四丈，粗够五个人合抱的。一只叫开明兽的九头神兽，守着西王母的大门。

[P16] 西王母很同情后羿，就叫三足神鸟衔来一个葫芦，交给后羿，对他说：“里面的不死药，是用不死树上的不死果炼成的。不死树三千年开一次花，六千年结一次果。”

[P17] 后羿拿了药，
历经千难万险终于
回到了家。他把不
死药交给嫦娥：“这
包药，两个人吃可
以长生不老，一个
人吃能回到天庭。
我们找个好日子一
起吃吧！”

嫦娥太想回天
庭了，一天晚上，
趁后羿不在家，她
翻出不死药，一口气
全都吃下去了。

[P18] 嫦娥的身体越来越轻，渐渐地她飘了起来，飘向天空。她害怕天帝迁怒于自己，只好飘向月宫。

[P19] 月宫里非常冷清，只有一棵桂树和一只白兔。嫦娥再也回不去人间了，
只好呆在月宫里，天天、月月、年年听那白兔捣药的声音。
张世明(1939— )
1939年生于上海。1954年毕业于上海行知艺术学校，1958年毕业于中央美术学院华东分院附中，上世纪八十年代曾在美国纽约艺术学生联盟进修版画和壁画。上海少年儿童出版社美术编辑。寓言故事绘本《守株待兔》、《滥竽充数》、《板桥三娘子》等曾获国际少年儿童图书插图协会大奖。《九色鹿》获全国儿童图画书一等奖。

Hou Yi Shoots the Suns
Illustrated by Zhang Shiming, Adapted by Xia Hong

[P4] Long ago, there were ten suns in the world, and they lived on the Fusang tree in the middle of the sea.
Each day, they took turns appearing in the sky, so people on the ground could only see one sun.
The rooster crows "cock-a-doodle-doo," and the suns' mother, Xihe, comes to take them on duty.

[P5] Xihe took one sun onto the chariot, and six dragons pulled them through the sky.

[P6] For millions of years, every day they had to go to work and come home. The ten suns found it too boring. One morning, without waiting for their mother to pick them up, they all rushed into the sky and started playing, jumping around.
5
The sunlight from the ten suns was too intense, scorching the land, drying up the crops, and making it impossible for people to survive.
6

[P7] Their father, Di Jun, found out about this and was very angry, so he sent Hou Yi to teach those ten troublemakers a lesson.
7
Hou Yi, carrying the bow and ten arrows given to him by Di Jun, came to the human world with his wife Chang'e. He
saw that many people had been scorched to death, and those still alive were nothing but bones, which made him extremely sad.
8

[P8] Houyi drew his bow and arrow, aimed at the suns, and warned them to stop causing trouble, but the ten of them completely ignored him and continued jumping around wildly in the sky.
9
Houyi shot an arrow with a 'whoosh'!

[P9] One sun fell to the ground, turning into a golden crow. The remaining nine were panic-stricken and fled in all directions.
11
Hou Yi shot eight arrows in quick succession, "whoosh whoosh whoosh," hitting one sun with each arrow.
12

[P10] People were worried that Houyi had shot down all ten suns. Without the sun, nothing could grow. So someone secretly took an arrow from Houyi's quiver.

[P11] 15  From then on, the sun became obedient, appearing on time every day, pouring sunlight upon the earth.
16  Chang'e Flies to the Moon

[P12] Houyi killed nine suns. Di Jun was very angry and ordered Houyi and Chang'e to be demoted to mortals, never to return to heaven again.

Chang'e was very sad. She was originally a goddess who could live forever, but now she could only grow old like a mortal.

[P13] Houyi felt very guilty. He asked around everywhere and finally discovered that the Queen Mother of the West in Kunlun Mountain kept the elixir of immortality. So, he bid farewell to Chang'e and went to Kunlun Mountain to search for the medicine.
Kunlun Mountain is surrounded by towering mountains reaching into the clouds. On the mountain, fierce fires burn, capable of melting copper into juice,
19 and iron into water, but they could not stop the brave Houyi.

[P14] At the foot of Kunlun Mountain flows a great river called Ruoshui. Feathers dropped by flying birds sink as soon as they touch the water. However, this cannot stop the strong Hou Yi. Kunlun Mountain is 11,114 steps, 2 feet, and 6 inches high, and the Tree of Immortality lies to the west.

[P15] After enduring many hardships, Hou Yi finally climbed to the top of Kunlun Mountain, where grew a kind of wooden grain, four zhang tall, thick enough for five people to embrace. A nine-headed divine beast called Kaoming兽 guarded the gate of the Queen Mother of the West.

[P16] The Queen Mother of the West felt sorry for Hou Yi, so she called a three-legged divine bird to bring a gourd, gave it to Hou Yi, and said: 'The elixir of immortality inside is made from the immortal fruit of the immortal tree. The immortal tree blooms once every three thousand years and bears fruit once every six thousand years.'

[P17] Houyi got the medicine,
and after enduring countless hardships, he finally
returned home. He handed the elixir of immortality to Chang'e: "This
package of medicine, if two people eat it, they can live forever; if one
person eats it, they can return to the heavenly realm.
Let's find a good day to take it together!"

Chang'e was so eager to return to the
heavenly realm that one night,
while Houyi was away, she
took out the elixir of immortality and swallowed it all in one go.

[P18] Chang'e's body became lighter and lighter. Gradually, she floated up into the sky. Afraid that the Heavenly Emperor would be angry with her, she could only float toward the Moon Palace.

[P19] The moon palace is very lonely, with only a cassia tree and a white rabbit. Chang'e can never return to the mortal world,
so she can only stay in the moon palace, day after day, month after month, year after year, listening to the sound of the white rabbit pounding medicine.
Zhang Shiming (1939— )
Born in Shanghai in 1939. Graduated from Shanghai Xingzhi Art School in 1954, and from the Affiliated High School of the East China Branch of the Central Academy of Fine Arts in 1958. In the 1980s, he studied printmaking and mural painting at the Art Students League in New York, USA. He was an art editor at Shanghai Children's Publishing House. His fable picture books, such as 'Waiting for Hares by the Stump', 'Masking the Flute', and 'Banqiao's Three Daughters', won the International Board on Books for Young People (IBBY) Award. 'The Nine-Colored Deer' won the First Prize of the National Children's Picture Book Award.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《嫦娥奔月》的封面，展示了嫦娥身着白衣、飘带飞舞，向明月飞去的场景，背景为深蓝色星空，画面中央有书名、作者和出版社信息。
[P2] 本页为纯色渐变背景，左侧为黄绿色漩涡纹理，右侧为蓝绿色漩涡纹理，无任何文字或图像内容，可能为绘本的内页分隔页或装饰页。
[P3] 本页左侧为《嫦娥奔月》的图书在版编目（CIP）数据，右侧为另一篇神话故事《后羿射日》的标题页，配有后羿拉弓射日的插图和作者信息。
[P4] 本页讲述了远古时期世界上有十个太阳，他们住在大海中央的扶桑树上，每天轮流出现，由太阳的妈妈曦和在公鸡打鸣后接他们值班。
[P5] 本页描绘了太阳女神曦和驾驶由六条龙拉动的马车，带着一个太阳在天空中飞奔的场景，画面以明亮的黄色为主调，展现了神话中的日行过程。
[P6] 本页描绘了十个太阳因觉得上班无聊而一同涌上天空玩耍，导致阳光过于强烈，烤焦土地、晒死庄稼，人们无法生存的场景。
[P7] 本页讲述了帝俊派后羿去教训十个太阳，后羿与妻子嫦娥来到人间，目睹了人们因十个太阳同时出现而遭受的苦难，感到非常难过。
[P8] 后羿拉弓搭箭警告十个太阳不要胡闹，但太阳们不理他，继续在天空中乱跳；随后后羿射出一箭，画面中箭矢射向太阳。
[P9] 本页描绘了后羿射日的高潮场景：一个太阳被射中后坠地化为金乌，其余九个太阳惊慌逃窜；后羿继续连射八箭，每箭射中一个太阳。
[P10] 人们担心后羿射杀所有太阳会导致万物无法生长，于是有人偷偷从后羿的箭袋中取出一支箭。画面左侧描绘了人们紧张担忧的场景，右侧则展现了后羿拉弓射日的动态画面。
[P11] 本页左侧描绘了太阳按时升起，大地恢复生机，人们安居乐业的景象；右侧则以标题“嫦娥奔月”和画面预示下一个神话故事的开始。
[P12] 后羿射死九个太阳后，帝俊大怒，将后羿和嫦娥贬为凡人，永世不得上天。嫦娥因此伤心，因为她原本是长生不老的女神，如今却要像凡人一样老去。
[P13] 后羿因被贬为凡人而内疚，决定去昆仑山寻找西王母的不死药，告别嫦娥后，他勇敢地穿越烈火环绕的险峻山峰。
[P14] 本页描述后羿为寻找不死药，穿越环绕昆仑山的弱水，画面展现他乘舟渡河的场景，以及他攀登昆仑山、射向太阳的壮举。
[P15] 后羿历经艰险登上昆仑山顶，发现山顶长有高大的木禾，并有一只名为开明兽的九头神兽守卫着西王母的大门。
[P16] 西王母同情后羿，命三足神鸟带来装有不死药的葫芦，并向后羿说明不死药的由来和珍贵。
[P17] 后羿历经艰险带回不死药，交给嫦娥并约定共同服用；嫦娥因思念天庭，趁后羿不在时独自吞下全部药丸。
[P18] 嫦娥因服用不死药身体变轻，飘向天空，因害怕天帝责罚而飞向月宫。
[P19] 本页左侧描绘了嫦娥独自在月宫中，身旁有桂树和捣药的白兔，画面传达出她的孤寂；右侧是作者张世明的生平简介。文字说明嫦娥因无法返回人间，只能在月宫中日复一日地听着白兔捣药的声音。
[P20] 本页为纯色抽象画面，左侧为黄绿色渐变，右侧为蓝绿色渐变，无任何文字或可识别图像元素，可能为绘本的过渡页或装饰页。
